name: Gall Family Foundation Achieving Potential Scholarship (Deakin Warrnambool)
summary: Up to $30,000 for domestic students facing hardship who start a bachelor degree on campus at Deakin Warrnambool.
key: $10,000 a year for three years or $7,500 a year for four, $30,000 in total.
who: Domestic student commencing an on-campus bachelor degree at Warrnambool in Trimester/Semester 1, 2027.
Full-time in a CSP unless circumstances prevent it.
how: Automatic if you submitted a VTAC equity schemes and scholarships application; otherwise apply in the Scholarship Application Portal.
catches: Applications close 5pm Wednesday 16 December 2026, re-offer round 20 January 2027.

source.label: Deakin: Gall Family Foundation Achieving Potential Scholarship

evidence.quote: Cash payments of up to $10,000 per year for three years or $7500 per year for four years.
